name: Azareel
overview: The name Azareel appears in Scripture associated with several individuals connected to the Levitical and tribal leadership of Israel. Notably, Azareel is identified as an Aaronite from the family of Korah and a temple musician, sometimes called Uzziel, who served with musical instruments during the time of Ezra and Nehemiah. Additionally, Azareel is mentioned as a Danite prince and as a son of Bani, indicating his role within the tribal and priestly structures. These references highlight Azareel's involvement in both worship and leadership among God's people during the post-exilic period.
